changelog:
Added
- Collection Curating: a Curate button that resurfaces one gallery at a time and asks you to fix it — rename the folder on disk, assign creators, tag, rate, set a cover, or delete. Save & next, forever. Curated galleries drop out of rotation for three months.
- Curating ranks by what's actually broken (no creator, no tags, scraper-hash folder names, never opened), not at random, and tells you why each gallery came up.
- About four in ten come from creators you love — a blend of how much you use her, her rating, and the favourite star — each with her own progress bar.
- Create a creator from inside the run, without leaving the gallery.
- Files that don't belong in a gallery can now be moved, split off into their own gallery, or deleted from inside Curating.
- Hall of Fame crowns: topping a day, week or month permanently crowns that creator and mints her a card for it. Crowns are tied to the date won and can never be re-won or farmed.
- Hall of Fame now has Today / This week / This month / All time, with its own #1 and collage per window.
- Every creator's stats open with an Honours board: every period she has topped, and the score that took it.
- Recap: a paced, full-screen story of your own behaviour over any window, from today to all time.
- Relocate: move any gallery, photo or video somewhere else on the drive. Nothing moves until you've checked the destination and answered any name clashes.
- Subgalleries: a gallery containing other galleries now lists them in a retractable section, expanded one level at a time.
- Stats > The Almanac: the long view — your collecting years, the phases of the collection, how you actually use it, and a written read computed from your own numbers.
- Session history is now editable, and you can add sessions the app never saw. Manual entries earn no XP.
- Erika's chat bubble can be dragged anywhere on screen and stays put.
- Scripted-only filter on the Videos tab, and Shuffle in the video player.

Changed
- Engagement is now recorded with a timestamp as it happens — views, watch time, cum taps and edges — so the periodic boards fill in as you use the app.
- The dashboard's Random Gallery tile is now the Collection Curating tile. Random galleries are still under Discover.
- Arrow keys are yours to set: choose whether left/right scrub the video or jump between files.

Fixed
- Searching for a destination gallery only looked at the first 2,000 galleries, so most searches on a large library returned nothing useful.
- Slideshows cut videos off partway instead of letting them play out, and cut GIFs mid-animation.
- Large GIFs sat as a blurred thumbnail for seconds before appearing.

Removed
- Daily Tagging, superseded by Collection Curating.
